draft.emotion: a thoughtful pause, light and reflective, as if searching one's memory
notes: When meaning 'to remember', it commonly takes 'de' in Brazil even without 'se': 'Eu lembro da festa' or formally 'Eu me lembro da festa' (I remember the party).
It can also mean 'to remind someone of' by resemblance: 'Ela lembra a mãe' (She looks like / reminds me of her mother).

senses.definition: To keep something in your mind or bring it back into your thoughts.
